integrity: The general randomized Douglas-Rachford algorithm, general Markov invariant-measure theory, ordinary stochastic resetting mathematics, and existing deterministic inconsistent DR are prior contributions. Independent priority verification is not performed.
scientific_limitations: Exactly three affine equations in two unknowns; independent sampling with replacement at each of two reflections; relaxation 1/2; q in (0,1), d>0, exact arithmetic; not a universal property of all Douglas-Rachford solvers.
title: An exact discrete-Laplace noise floor for randomized Douglas–Rachford on inconsistent rows
